title: Let’s Take a Walk in Another World
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Sora is summoned from Japan to a fantasy world as a hero, but his only skill is 'Walking'. Rejected as useless and dumped outside the palace, he discovers that every step earns experience, and as he travels he gains skills such as Examine, Alchemy and Domestic Magic.
life_message: Steady, humble effort, one step at a time, can outgrow the judgment of those who wrote you off.
